risk_summary: The excerpt uses substantial standard accounting-policy boilerplate and emphasizes uncertainty in loan-loss, valuation, tax, and impairment estimates. Credit risk has worsened materially, with substandard loans rising to $130.5 million, including $80.3 million of taxi medallion loans, and $78.5 million of performing taxi-medallion TDRs modified to interest-only payments. The disclosure is reasonably quantified but leaves meaningful uncertainty around ultimate loss severity and required future provisions.
